correctness.rationale: The squared Cayley reductions, Enestrom-Kakeya localization, exact derivative-product discriminant, discriminant covariance, and Erdos-Turan/root-product weak-limit argument were checked in the original same-model review.

originality.rationale: The source computes Disc(p_n) but not the exact companion formula; targeted searches found no exact overlap. Classical zero and discriminant tools were treated as background.

value.rationale: The result gives finite-degree root geometry, a Cauchy zero law, and a closed companion discriminant for the new families.
